# LEADTO Sanitary Ware

> Ceramic sanitary ware manufacturer and exporter in Chaozhou, Guangdong, China.
> 24,220 models across toilets, basins, urinals, bathtubs, bathroom suites and bidets.
> OEM/ODM, mixed container loading, export packing. No retail, quotation only.

## Contact

- Email: sales@leadtoware.com

## Key facts

- Company: LEADTO Sanitary Ware (brand LEADTO). Ceramic sanitary ware manufacturer and exporter.
- Location: Fengtang, Chao'an District, Chaozhou, Guangdong, China — China's largest sanitary ware production region.
- Range: 24,220 models across 16 categories (toilets, basins, urinals and squat pans, bathtubs, bathroom suites, bidets, flush valves and sensor faucets, bathroom cabinets, mirrors, faucets, showers, kitchen sinks, floor drains, bathroom accessories, shower enclosures, valves).
- Business model: B2B only. Wholesale, OEM and ODM. No retail. Prices are quotation-only — request by model code with quantity and destination port.
- Payment terms: T/T. Production 25–35 days after deposit receipt.
- Logistics: mixed-SKU container loading, export-grade cartons and foam protection.
- Contact: sales@leadtoware.com
